finding_reviews.statement: Bounded coupled transport captures known depletion/resistance but loses strongly to a tuned kernel on the original reserved temperature.
finding_reviews.historical_evidence_status: Original historical reserve status is retained in source records; every outcome is exposed now. Continuation model selection uses development evidence but cannot restore fresh confirmation.
finding_reviews.strongest_adverse_evidence: Calibrated exponents 0.633–0.668 reproduce known nonideal pressure response; four devices and intersecting flow/composition slices cannot identify independent resistances.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Complete gas-temperature blocks across four calibrated membranes; pure-H2 calibration belongs to all matched comparators. Strong adverse evidence: Calibrated exponents 0.633–0.668 reproduce known nonideal pressure response; four devices and intersecting flow/composition slices cannot identify independent resistances.

mechanism.rationale: Conservation, nonlinear film resistance and entrance effects are grounded in established transport. Effective gas mass scaling omits collision integrals/viscosity; fitted families are calibration, not universal constants.

novelty.rationale: Source-matching paper already contains axial/film transport; contribution is a smaller local closure and falsification, not new transport theory. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
